posts.title: Dhaka German Embassy Category A appointment timeline for Winter 2026
posts.content: Assalamu Alaikum everyone! For those who received conditional or direct admission letters from German universities, what is the current wait time between registering on the waiting list and receiving the appointment booking link? Does having an IELTS 7.5 and German GPA 1.5 give priority slot? Please share your recent experiences.

posts.title: Urgent: Safe ways to avoid WG-Gesucht scams before landing in Munich
posts.content: I am flying to Munich in October for the semester start. I found a couple of sublets on WG-Gesucht where the landlord claims they are currently in Spain and asking to transfer deposit via Western Union or Airbnb link before sending keys. Is this 100% a scam? How do seniors recommend securing temporary housing legally with Anmeldung (registration)?

posts.title: Guide: Blocked Account transfer with Bangladesh Bank outward student remittance
posts.content: Wanted to post a verified checklist since many consultancies charge extra 20k BDT just to do this! You can open student file directly at City Bank, Eastern Bank, or BRAC Bank with your admission letter and sponsor tax documents. Fintiba or Expatrio IBAN gets credited within 48 hours. Don't pay middlemen for remittance.

posts.title: Study Permit approval timeline with Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL)
posts.content: Applied from Dhaka under university category with PAL from Ontario. Medical was updated within 10 days. Total processing took 6 weeks. Make sure your proof of funds shows genuine bank statements with at least 6 months history and tax certificates of your parents.

posts.title: Looking for flatmates near University of Toronto St. George campus (Fall '26)
posts.content: Hi everyone! I received admission for M.Sc. in Computer Science at U of T. Looking for 1 or 2 female flatmates to rent a 2-bedroom apartment along the TTC Line 1 (Spadina, Dupont, or St. Clair). Budget is around $800-$1000 CAD per room. Please comment or DM me!

posts.title: Part-time work regulations for off-campus students (24 hours rule update)
posts.content: Can any senior confirm if the new 24-hours per week limit is actively enforced for the Fall 2026 semester? Also, is it realistic to balance 24 hours of part-time work with graduate engineering coursework?

posts.title: 28-day maintenance funds rule: common mistakes that cause visa rejection
posts.content: Warning to all UK applicants: the funds MUST remain consecutively above the threshold for 28 days before the date of visa fee payment. Even dropping by 100 Taka for 1 hour resets the 28-day clock! Also ensure the bank manager signs with official stamp and bank letterhead stating they allow international transfers.

posts.title: UCL vs University of Manchester for Data Science / AI
posts.content: Got offers from both UCL (London) and Manchester for MSc Data Science. Living expenses in London are almost double Manchester according to my estimates. Is the UCL brand prestige worth the higher tuition and rent differential?

posts.title: Cold-emailing templates that got me 3 funded Graduate RA interview invites
posts.content: For anyone applying for Fall '26 MS/PhD in USA: do NOT send generic template emails copy-pasted to 50 professors. Read at least 2 recent papers from the professor's lab, identify one concrete gap or dataset extension, and attach a 1-page research summary. Happy to share my exact pitch in DM.

posts.title: Dhaka US Embassy F-1 Visa Interview questions (Approved with Full Funding)
posts.content: Interview lasted only 2 minutes at counter 7. VO asked 3 questions: 1) Why this university? 2) Who is sponsoring your education? 3) What is your post-graduation career plan? Since I had full RA funding listed on my I-20, VO didn't even ask for bank statements. Just answered clearly with direct eye contact.

comments.content: For Category A (direct unrestricted admission with German GPA <= 1.5 or IELTS >= 7.5), appointment slots typically take 3 to 6 weeks from registration. Make sure all your original certificates are verified and your Expatrio/Fintiba confirmation document has the 05 error code absent.

Seconding Tanvir's point. Also, never cancel an allocated appointment date even if your semester start date is tight — the embassy is accommodating if your university provides a late arrival extension letter.

100% classic scam! Never transfer money before doing a live video call or having a trusted senior visit the apartment physically. For your first month, book an official Jugendherberge (Youth Hostel) or an Airbnb that explicitly allows 'Wohnungsgeberbestätigung' (City Registration document).
Thank you Tanvir bhai! That saved a lot of grief. I was also targeted by a similar profile asking for 600 Euros upfront. Beware everyone!
